svg.text: Each player is his own population
His own games, his own category boundaries, his own means. A red line is a boundary between two of his categories; a blue tick is a category mean. The categories
shown are the ones in force at the end of his record.
The shape under each boundary is a property, not a gate: a half that is still bimodal is a fact about that player, not a failure of the data.
The metric is the share of his evaluated days on which the actual landed in the category the model called. His reference is what naming his biggest category every
